title: runstate's maintenance-arm fixture fails on this host at the base commit
body: TestTheStoresFetchStartsNoMaintenanceInTheRepositoryItWritesTo (internal/runstate/maintenance_test.go) fails deterministically on this host with 'a plain git fetch in the armed repository started no maintenance; this fixture proves nothing' — reproduced with all w9b changes stashed, i.e. pre-existing and environment-dependent, likely related to open tick cy2's class (host/git-version-dependent fixtures). Worth investigating under cy2 rather than as a new tick.
